A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DisCO research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reasoning-model fine-tuning results, benchmark evaluations, training dynamics, and ablations in Section 6 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds Llama-8B evaluations, DAPO-Math-17K training results, and further ablations.

M1.justification: The discriminative objectives, two scoring functions, DRO treatment of negative outputs, and squared-hinge KL constraint penalty remain unchanged in Equations 7–11 and Algorithm 1. Testing additional model configurations does not alter DisCO.

E1.justification: Appendix A.3 adds DAPO-Math-17K as a second mathematical training corpus alongside DeepScaleR. The mathematical reasoning task and all six evaluation datasets remain unchanged, making this a limited extension within existing task coverage.

E2.justification: The main benchmark comparisons retain GRPO, GRPO-ER, Dr. GRPO, DAPO, TRPA, and the existing externally trained reference models. Figure 4 adds comparison controls using KL-regularized and question-weighted versions of DisCO or DisCO-b.

E3.justification: v3 adds Llama-8B experiments with 1,000 training steps and a preferred learning rate of 5e-7. It expands parameter grids, changes the stated sensitivity-study budget from 1,000 to 1,400 steps, and adds clipping and KL-regularization controls. These substantially extend the experimental design; the shared 8k response limit and pass@1 evaluation remain.

E4.justification: Section 6.2 adds direct KL regularization versus constraint comparisons and individual component tests, extends clipping analysis to epsilon-high 0.28, and revises the sensitivity study. Appendix A.2 adds Llama training-dynamics analysis. The existing DisCO-versus-DisCO-b study is retained and updated, not newly introduced.

E5.justification: Both versions estimate pass@1 using 16 responses per question. Neither reports training-seed counts, independent repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 2–3 retain their numerical results. New Tables 4–5 report DisCO log-L averages of 0.584 for Llama-8B and 0.541 after DAPO-Math-17K training, versus corresponding GRPO averages of 0.516 and 0.473. Ablation and sensitivity results also change. These are added or revised results under their respective settings, not same-setting improvements between versions.

T1.justification: Proposition 1 replaces y with |y| in its subtracted negative-reward term, correcting a sign inconsistency with the decomposition proved in Appendix B.1. Equation 5 is expressed more compactly; the substantive appendix proofs and derivations are retained.

C1.justification: The introduction broadens the stated empirical superiority from Qwen-1.5B/7B to Qwen and Llama models and corrects the contribution summary from six other baselines to four. The principal novelty, difficulty-bias, stability, and discriminative-learning claims remain.

C2.justification: The new ablations explicitly connect performance differences to constrained optimization and identify non-clipping as the largest component contribution. Appendix A extends the stability interpretation to Llama and interprets the second training corpus as evidence of generalizability. Existing mechanism explanations and applicability assumptions remain.

D1.justification: v3 documents Llama-specific learning-rate and training-budget choices, revised search ranges, and explicit settings for the added controls. Existing optimizer, batching, temperature, hardware, and runtime disclosures remain. The same code repository is retained, with its link relocated.

R1.justification: The reference attached to the retained OlympiadBench evaluation changes from Huang et al.'s OlympicArena to He et al.'s OlympiadBench. The broader related-work discussion and research positioning remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized prose edits, introduces model shorthand, moves experimental setup outside subsection 6.1, adds appendix subsections, and updates author and conference information. Most existing narrative, method exposition, and proof text is retained.

P2.justification: v3 adds two empirical tables and Llama training plots, and substantially expands and reorganizes the ablation displays across Figures 3–4. Existing appendix Figure 4 and Table 4 become Figure 5 and Table 6; these relocations are distinguished from the new displays.

improvement.justification: The additional model family, training corpus, and direct component controls strengthen support for DisCO's portability and design choices beyond v1's existing empirical case. The sign and benchmark-citation corrections also improve accuracy. The gains remain incremental: small ablation differences lack run-level uncertainty, and the KL comparison tests only one regularization weight.
